title: Foundations
what: Build core concepts from your school syllabus before touching Olympiad-level problems. Focus on accuracy over speed.

title: Intermediate
what: Work through Olympiad problems by topic. Start recognising the patterns that sit behind the problems.

title: Advanced
what: Tackle multi-concept and proof-based problems. Develop rigorous, competition-grade arguments.

title: Simulation
what: Attempt full-length past papers under real timing. Build stamina and exam temperament.

title: Olympiad
what: Final refinement. Light practice, weak-area review, and peak taper before the national round.
